## ITC's Technico Australia Turnover

According to ITC's FY25 annual report, Technico Pty Limited, Australia registered a turnover of Australian Dollars (A$) 2.86 million (previous year A$ 1.69 million) and a Net Profit of A$ 1.51 million (previous year A$ 0.81 million).

Note: The report also shows Technico Pty Limited's turnover in Indian Rupees terms (as reported under the Companies Act subsidiary disclosure) at ₹20.43 crore, with an exchange rate on the last day of the financial year of 53.8100 (INR per AUD) — this was the rate used in the company's own FY25 financial statements (as of March 31, 2025).

## Converting to Today's Exchange Rate

As of today (September 28, 2026), the mid-market AUD/INR exchange rate is approximately **₹67.20 per AUD** (rates across sources range narrowly between ~67.19–67.31).

Applying today's rate to Technico's A$2.86 million turnover:

**A$2.86 million × ₹67.20 ≈ ₹192.18 million (approximately ₹19.22 crore)**

For comparison, at the FY25 year-end rate used in ITC's own accounts (₹53.81/AUD), the same A$2.86 million would have translated to roughly ₹153.9 million (~₹15.39 crore) — meaning the rupee equivalent has risen by about 25% due to AUD's appreciation against the INR since March 2025.
